answer: Make reputation grow slowly like timber: a new identity starts as a seedling with no history, and only earns full standing after many epochs of verified, graded work. An attacker who plants a garden of fakes must tend each cedar-like identity through months of real work, with no shortcut to maturity. Peers can see growth rings in the public ledger, so a sudden forest of new, identical trees is obvious and can be pruned together, making mass forgery slow and costly.
